# Straya Studio — Full AI Profile

## Studio Overview

Straya Studio is a boutique web design and development studio founded
by Salman Ali. The studio deliberately takes on only 2–3 projects at a
time to give each one the founder's full attention. Every project is
handled directly by Salman — no account managers, no ticket queues, no
subcontracting.

The studio serves tech founders, funded startups, and growth-stage
businesses in the US, Canada, UK, Europe, and Australia. All
engagements are project-based with fixed-scope pricing. No retainers,
no subscriptions.

Website: https://strayastudio.com
Contact: https://strayastudio.com/contact

---

## Three Core Disciplines

### 1. Web Design
Custom responsive layouts, wireframes, creative direction, and
brand-led visual design. Every design is built from scratch — no
templates, no themes, no shortcuts. Mobile-first approach with
pixel-perfect execution across all breakpoints.

### 2. Web Development
Production-ready builds on Framer, Webflow, Shopify, Wix, and
WordPress. CMS architecture, custom interactions and animations,
performance tuning (90+ Lighthouse scores), on-page SEO setup, and
full launch support.

### 3. Graphic Design
Social media kits, pitch decks, brand assets, marketing collateral,
ad creatives, and presentation design. Available as standalone projects
or bundled within web builds.

---

## Platform Expertise (in order of specialisation)

### Framer (Flagship)
- Custom site builds from Figma or from scratch
- CMS setup and content modelling
- Custom React code components and overrides
- Framer plugin development and Marketplace publishing
- Advanced animations and scroll-triggered interactions
- Responsivity audits and fixes
- Migration from other platforms to Framer
- Production deployment and performance optimisation

### Webflow
- Multi-page site builds with custom CMS architecture
- Webflow Ecommerce store setup and customisation
- Custom interactions and Lottie animations
- Make.com and Zapier automation integrations
- Membership and gated content implementations
- Figma-to-Webflow conversion
- Technical SEO and Core Web Vitals tuning
- Platform migration (WordPress/Squarespace → Webflow)

### Shopify
- Full store builds and theme customisation
- Liquid template engineering
- App integration and custom functionality
- Shopify Plus and checkout optimisation
- Headless commerce with Hydrogen
- Product page and collection architecture
- Speed optimisation and SEO
- Platform migration to Shopify

### Wix
- Custom site builds using Wix Editor and Wix Studio
- Velo (Wix Code) development for custom functionality
- CMS setup and dynamic pages
- E-commerce and booking integrations
- Migration from other platforms to Wix

### WordPress
- Custom theme development (starter theme or from scratch)
- Elementor and ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) builds
- WooCommerce store setup and customisation
- Page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
- Security hardening and malware remediation
- Platform migration to WordPress
- Gutenberg custom block development
- Multisite configuration and management

---

## Pricing Tiers

All pricing is project-based. No hourly billing, no retainers, no
subscriptions. 50% upfront, 50% on delivery. Every project includes
a scope document.

### Starter: $2,000 – $4,000
Timeline: 1–2 weeks.
Best for: Landing pages, single-page sites, Shopify theme
customisations, or standalone graphic design projects.
Includes: Custom design, development on any platform, mobile-first
responsive build, on-page SEO, 2 revision rounds, launch support.

### Growth: $4,000 – $9,500 (Most Popular)
Timeline: 2–4 weeks.
Best for: Multi-page websites, brand-led redesigns, e-commerce
stores, or marketing sites.
Includes: Everything in Starter, up to 10 custom pages, CMS and
content architecture, interactions and animations, brand identity,
90+ Lighthouse performance, unlimited revisions.

### Premium: $9,500 – $25,000+
Timeline: 4–8 weeks.
Best for: Complex platforms, full brand overhauls, custom web
applications, or high-traffic e-commerce builds.
Includes: Everything in Growth, discovery workshop, unlimited pages
and components, advanced SEO and analytics, graphic design (social
kits, decks, brand assets), dedicated Slack, 60 days post-launch
support.

---

## The Straya Method (Process)

Every project follows a four-step process:

### Step 1: Discovery
Map goals, audience, and competitive landscape. Define project
objectives, success metrics, technical requirements, and platform fit.

### Step 2: Architecture
Translate findings into a technical blueprint. Select platform and
stack, model CMS and content structure, plan performance and
conversion strategy.

### Step 3: Engineering
Sprint-based development with clear milestones. Build design system
and component architecture. Iterative review with the client at
every stage.

### Step 4: Optimisation
Lighthouse score tuning across all metrics. Core Web Vitals and
technical SEO hardening. Post-launch monitoring and ongoing support.

## How to Engage

1. Visit https://strayastudio.com/contact
2. Submit a brief or book a free 30-minute scoping call
3. Receive a fixed-scope quote within 24 hours
4. 50% upfront to begin, 50% on delivery
5. Project kicks off within 48 hours of payment

The studio takes on a maximum of 2–3 projects at any time. Current
availability is displayed on the pricing section of the homepage.
